name: Takanashi Mahiru
source:
Likes: Rice crackers, allegories
Dislikes: Things like ghosts, darkness

A lovely ghost girl whom for an unknown reason only [url=/c4059]Yoshiyuki[/url] can see. She wants to rest in peace, but unfortunately, she doesn't know what holds her in this world. While alive, she had a faithful friend, [url=/c6037]Miki Asahina[/url], who cared for her until her last moments. Could she be related to her somehow? Yoshiyuki agrees to help Mahiru to find the reason. But the problem is that Mahiru gradually begins to see her ideal boy in this guy...
